{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('data/penguins.csv')

# Check for missing values in the two variables of interest
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()

# Check the number of complete cases
complete_cases = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']).shape[0]

missing_flipper, missing_body_mass, complete_cases"}
